# Continent 8 Technologies brings in Mike Small as new CEO

4th August 2026 9:44 am

_Founder Michael Tobin steps down as CEO after 28 years and transitions to chairman role_

Continent 8 Technologies has appointed Mike Small as its new chief executive officer to succeed Michael Tobin, who transitions to the role of chairman.

Small brings more than 25 years of global technology leadership experience to the role and most recently served as president of Akkodis North America and US country president of The Adecco Group, where he played a key role in advancing the organisation’s AI strategy.
He previously served as Americas CEO at Sitel Group and held senior leadership positions with IBM, Hewlett Packard, Capgemini, and VXI & SYMBIO Global Solutions.

Over the past year, Small has served as a strategic board advisor to Continent 8, working closely with the executive leadership team.

Based in Miami, he will lead Continent 8’s next phase of growth, focused on expanding the company’s global presence, strengthening customer partnerships, and advancing its portfolio of infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, and AI-enabled technology solutions.

“After 28 remarkable years leading Continent 8, I am incredibly proud of what our team has built and achieved,” said Tobin, who founded the company in 1998. “This transition has been thoughtfully planned, and I have complete confidence in Mike’s ability to lead the company into its next chapter.

#### **Global iGaming and sports betting IT solutions provider [Continent 8 Technologies](https://agbrief.com/news/world/28/05/2026/continent-8-releases-intelligence8-suite-ai-solutions/) has appointed [Mike Small](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mikepsmall/) as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective 15 July 2026. He succeeds founder Michael Tobin, who is stepping into the role of Chairman after 28 years at the helm.**

Mike Small brings over 25 years of global leadership experience across the technology sector.
Before joining Continent 8, he served as President of Akkodis North America and US Country President at The Adecco Group, where he oversaw large-scale technology, engineering, managed services, and workforce solutions operations. During his tenure, he played a pivotal role in shaping the group’s AI strategy, driving the adoption of artificial intelligence to help clients accelerate innovation, enhance operational efficiency, and prepare for the future of work.

Earlier in his career, Small served as CEO – Americas at Sitel Group and held senior leadership roles at IBM, Hewlett Packard, Capgemini, and VXI & SYMBIO Global Solutions.

Over the past year, he has also acted as a Strategic Board Advisor to Continent 8, working closely with its executive leadership team.

...

Tobin will work closely with Small and the Continent 8 executive team to ensure a seamless leadership transition while focusing on governance, long-term strategy, and key stakeholder relationships in his role as Chairman.

**Commenting on his new role as CEO at Continent 8 Technologies, Mike Small, added:** “Continent 8 has built an exceptional reputation for delivering mission-critical technology solutions to customers operating in highly regulated and latency-sensitive environments. Having worked closely with the company over the 12 months, I have seen first-hand the strength of the business, the talent of our people, and the opportunities ahead. I look forward to working with our team to deepen customer partnerships, accelerate innovation, and continue delivering the secure, resilient, and high-performance solutions our customers depend on.”

Continent 8’s global footprint
Since its founding in 1998, [Continent 8 has grown into one of the iGaming industry’s most trusted technology providers](https://agbrief.com/news/world/19/05/2026/continent-8-introduces-managed-cockroachdb-service-for-igaming/) , operating a global network of more than [100 connected data centres across four continents](https://www.continent8.com/locations/) and over 30 US states. The company delivers mission-critical infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, connectivity, and managed services that support many of the world’s leading iGaming operators and platform providers.

# Continent 8 Welcomes Mike Small as CEO, Michael Tobin Becomes Chair

[Angel Hristov](https://www.gamblingnews.com/news/author/angel/)

Published by [Angel Hristov](https://www.gamblingnews.com/news/author/angel/)

·

Fact-checked by [Stoyan Todorov](https://www.gamblingnews.com/news/author/stoyan/)

Likes: 0 i Reaction details Reactions

**Key Points**

* Continent 8 Technologies announced the appointment of a new chief executive officer
* The one assuming the position is the experienced Mike Small
* Michael Tobin, who has served as CEO for 28 years, will now become chair

change-hire-appoint-innovate-news

Image Source: Shutterstock.com

Leading online gaming and betting IT solutions provider **Continent 8 Technologies** announced major leadership changes, including the appointment of a new CEO. This comes as the company’s founder, **Michael Tobin** , decided to step down from the chief executive seat after 28 years in the position.
## Continent 8 to Welcome a New CEO for the First Time in 28 Years

According to Continent 8’s announcement, Tobin will not be leaving the company, but transitioning to chair. At the same time, **Mike Small** has been appointed as the business’ new chief executive officer, effective **July 15, 2026** .

In a press release published on **August 3** , Continent 8 described Small as a tech industry veteran with some **25 years of leadership experience** . Before joining Continent 8, he served as president of Akkodis North America and US Country president of The Adecco Group. During his time with Adecco, Small led large-scale technology, engineering, managed services, and workforce solutions businesses and spearheaded the company’s AI strategy.

Small’s prior experiences include time as CEO for the Americas for Sitel Group, as well as senior leadership positions at the likes of IBM, Hewlett Packard, Capgemini, and VXI & SYMBIO Global Solutions.
The appointee is no stranger to Continent 8’s business either, **having served as a strategic board advisor** to the company for a year. During that time, he brushed shoulders with the executive leadership and familiarized himself with the company.

As CEO of Continent 8, Small will be tasked with ushering in a new phase of international growth, while strengthening the company’s customer partnerships and growing its solutions portfolio.

Tobin will work closely with the new CEO to ensure a smooth transition of responsibilities. In the meantime, his new role will see him focus on the company’s governance, strategy, and shareholder relationships.

## The Leadership Change Was “Thoughtfully Planned”

Tobin commented on his departure from the CEO role, saying that he feels proud of how far Continent 8 has come in the past three decades. He said that his decision to step down was carefully planned to ensure the company’s stability.
> This transition has been thoughtfully planned, and I have complete confidence in Mike’s ability to lead the company into its next chapter. His experience in scaling global technology businesses and his deep understanding of our customers and strategy, makes him the ideal leader to build on the strong foundation we have created.
> 
> Michael Tobin, chair, Continent 8 Technologies

Small also commented on his appointment, hailing the opportunity to serve a company with such a strong reputation. After spending 12 months with the business, he became convinced of its strength and potential.

Small concluded: “I look forward to working with our team to deepen customer partnerships, accelerate innovation, and continue delivering the secure, resilient, and high-performance solutions our customers depend on.”
